task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.97, 0.99, 0.84, 0.38, 0.34, 0.16, 0.73, 0.21] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
